displayTitle: Return of the Jedi: Han Solo's Rescue
synopsis: Return of the Jedi Han Solo's Rescue Pop-Up Book is a young reader book published by Random House in 1983. This short book depicts six major scenes from the Han Solo's rescue from Star Wars: Episode VI Return of the Jedi, each scene featuring one pop-up. All takes place on Tatooine.
title: Return of the Jedi: Han Solo's Rescue
